scenarios.title: Successful User Authentication and Redirection to Products Page
scenarios.business_objective: Allow valid registered users to securely authenticate and access the shop product catalogue.
preconditions: User is registered with valid credentials (e.g., username 'alice' and password 'alice-pass-1')
User is on the login page
steps: Navigate to the shop login page
Enter valid username and password into the respective form fields
Submit the login form
scenarios.expected_result: User is successfully authenticated and landed on the Products page.

scenarios.title: Authentication Failure due to Incorrect Password
scenarios.business_objective: Prevent unauthorized user access when an incorrect password is provided without disclosing credential specifics.
preconditions: User account exists in the system
User is on the login page
steps: Navigate to the shop login page
Enter a valid username and an incorrect password
Submit the login form
scenarios.expected_result: Authentication fails, user remains on the login page, and the exact message 'Invalid username or password' is displayed without revealing that the password was wrong.

scenarios.title: Authentication Failure due to Unknown Username
scenarios.business_objective: Prevent account enumeration attacks by providing generic error messages for non-existent user accounts.
preconditions: User is on the login page
steps: Navigate to the shop login page
Enter an unregistered/unknown username and any password
Submit the login form
scenarios.expected_result: Authentication fails, user remains on the login page, and the exact message 'Invalid username or password' is displayed without revealing that the username does not exist.

scenarios.title: Server-Side Session Invalidation Upon Logout
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure user sessions are invalidated server-side on logout so that old session credentials cannot be reused.
preconditions: User is currently signed in with an active server session
steps: Initiate logout from the application
Attempt to access a protected page (e.g., Products page) using the previous session cookie
scenarios.expected_result: The server rejects the request with the invalidated session cookie and redirects the request to the login page.

scenarios.title: Access Restriction for Unauthenticated Navigation
scenarios.business_objective: Enforce authentication rules by permitting unauthenticated access only to login, help, and health check endpoints while redirecting protected pages.
preconditions: User is not signed in
steps: Access the login page, help page, and health check endpoint successfully
Attempt to access any protected shop URL (e.g., Products page, Cart, Admin page) directly
scenarios.expected_result: Unauthenticated access to public endpoints succeeds, but attempts to visit any protected page immediately redirect the user to the login page.

scenarios.title: Accessibility Verification for Login Controls and Alerts
scenarios.business_objective: Provide an accessible login experience with programmatically linked visible labels and screen-reader announced error messages.
preconditions: Login page is rendered in the user browser
steps: Inspect Username and Password input fields on the login page
Trigger a failed login attempt to generate an error message
scenarios.expected_result: Visible labels exist for both Username and Password inputs with programmatic association (accessible name), and the error message is announced using role='alert'.

scenarios.title: API Session Authentication and Authorization
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure API endpoints require active user authentication and return HTTP 401 when unauthorized, except for health check.
preconditions: JSON API server is active under /api/
steps: Send an unauthenticated request to GET /api/health
Send unauthenticated requests to protected endpoints such as GET /api/products, POST /api/products, or GET /api/orders/{id}
Authenticate and re-send request to GET /api/products with a valid session
scenarios.expected_result: GET /api/health succeeds without authentication; unauthenticated requests to protected API endpoints return HTTP 401 Unauthorized; authenticated API requests succeed.

scenarios.title: Product Catalogue Browsing, Pagination, and Footer Help Navigation
scenarios.business_objective: Verify that customers can browse paginated products (5 per page) with Previous/Next controls and access the Help page from the footer without signing in.
preconditions: The catalogue contains more than 5 products.
The user is navigating the store.
steps: Navigate to the Products page (/products).
Verify that exactly 5 products are displayed along with the 'Page 1 of M' indicator and a Next link.
Click the Next link to navigate to Page 2.
Scroll to the page footer and click the 'Help' link.
scenarios.expected_result: Page 1 displays 5 products and 'Page 1 of M'. Clicking Next loads Page 2 with 5 products and 'Page 2 of M' with Previous enabled. Clicking 'Help' opens /help successfully without requiring authentication.

scenarios.title: Case-Insensitive Product Search and Special Character Handling
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure product search handles mixed-case terms and special SQL/symbol characters without system errors.
preconditions: The product catalogue contains items like 'wireless Mouse'.
The user is on the Products page search section.
steps: Enter 'mouse' into the product search bar and execute the search.
Verify that 'wireless Mouse' appears in the search results.
Enter search terms containing special characters (e.g., '%', '_', single quotes, or symbols) and submit the search.
scenarios.expected_result: Searching 'mouse' returns 'wireless Mouse' (case-insensitive match). Searching with special characters processes without application error and displays matching products or 'No products found'.

scenarios.title: Stable Price Sorting Preserving Catalogue Order
scenarios.business_objective: Confirm price sorting maintains consistent catalogue ordering for products with identical prices.
preconditions: Multiple products share identical price values in the catalogue.
The user is viewing the Products page.
steps: Select 'Price: Low to High' from the sort dropdown.
Observe the ordering of products that have identical prices.
Select 'Price: High to Low' from the sort dropdown.
Observe the secondary ordering of products sharing equal prices.
scenarios.expected_result: Products are sorted by price, and products with identical prices strictly preserve their product ID / catalogue name sequence in both low-to-high and high-to-low sorts.

scenarios.title: Filter, Search, and Sort Retention Across Pagination
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure active filter, search, and sort query parameters persist when navigating between pagination pages.
preconditions: A category contains more than 5 products.
The user is on the Products page.
steps: Select a specific product category filter and enter a search keyword.
Apply a price sorting option.
Click the Next pagination link to navigate to Page 2.
scenarios.expected_result: Page 2 loads maintaining active category, search, and sort parameters, presenting only items meeting the filtered criteria.

scenarios.title: API Search, Filtering, and Pagination Mirroring
scenarios.business_objective: Validate that GET /api/products mirrors UI parameters, rules, and performance expectations.
preconditions: An active authenticated user session exists.
Products exist in the database.
steps: Send a GET request to `/api/products` passing `q`, `category`, `sort`, and `page=2` query parameters.
Measure endpoint response latency.
scenarios.expected_result: The endpoint returns HTTP 200 OK within 2 seconds with a JSON payload matching the UI filtering, sorting, and 5-item pagination results.

scenarios.title: API Authentication Enforcement and Health Endpoint Exception
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure unauthenticated requests to API endpoints return HTTP 401, while /api/health remains publicly accessible.
preconditions: The HTTP client has no active user session.
steps: Send an unauthenticated GET request to `/api/health`.
Send an unauthenticated GET request to `/api/products`.
Send an unauthenticated GET request to `/api/orders/101`.
scenarios.expected_result: GET /api/health responds with HTTP 200 OK. Requests to /api/products and /api/orders/101 are rejected with HTTP 401 Unauthorized.

scenarios.title: Product Creation API Validation and Authorization
scenarios.business_objective: Verify POST /api/products payload validation and HTTP 422 error response handling.
preconditions: An active authenticated session is present.
steps: Send a POST request to `/api/products` with an invalid JSON payload missing mandatory fields such as `name` or `price`.
Verify response status and error body.
Send a POST request to `/api/products` containing valid JSON payload with `{name, price, category, description}`.
scenarios.expected_result: The invalid payload request yields HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity with error details. The complete payload request successfully creates the product.

scenarios.title: Role-Based Order Isolation and Admin Access Rights
scenarios.business_objective: Confirm customers can access only their own orders while administrators can access all orders and the Admin page.
preconditions: Customer A owns Order 101.
Customer B owns Order 102.
An Administrator user account exists.
steps: Sign in as Customer A and attempt to access Order 101.
Attempt to access Order 102 while signed in as Customer A.
Sign in as Administrator and access Order 101, Order 102, and the Admin page.
scenarios.expected_result: Customer A views Order 101 successfully but receives an authorization error for Order 102. Administrator successfully views Order 101, Order 102, and accesses the Admin page.

scenarios.title: Product List UI Page Load SLA Performance
scenarios.business_objective: Verify that the UI product list page renders completely within the required 2-second time frame.
preconditions: The application product catalogue is populated.
steps: Navigate to the Products page (/products).
Measure total rendering load time.
scenarios.expected_result: The Products UI page loads completely and displays product content within 2 seconds.

scenarios.title: Create Product Successfully with Valid Information
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure signed-in users can create a new product with all mandatory and optional fields within permitted limits.
preconditions: User is signed in
User is on the Add Product page
steps: Navigate to the Add Product form.
Enter a product name containing exactly 50 characters into the Name field.
Enter a positive price with up to two decimal places (e.g., '29.99') into the Price field.
Select 'Electronics' from the Category dropdown options.
Enter an optional product description within 500 characters into the Description field.
Click the Save button.
scenarios.expected_result: The product is saved successfully, appears in the product catalogue, and the user is notified of successful creation.

scenarios.title: Validate Product Name Mandatory and Length Constraints
scenarios.business_objective: Verify that empty product names or names exceeding 50 characters are rejected with appropriate error messages.
preconditions: User is signed in and on the Add/Edit Product form
steps: Leave the Product Name blank while entering valid Price ('10.00') and Category ('Books').
Click the Save button and observe validation response.
Enter a Product Name with 51 characters.
Click the Save button.
scenarios.expected_result: The blank submission is rejected with 'Name is required'. The 51-character name submission is rejected with 'Name must be at most 50 characters'.

scenarios.title: Validate Product Price Non-Negativity
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure that entering a negative price for a product is rejected on both client and server.
preconditions: User is signed in on the Add Product form
steps: Enter 'Valid Product Name' into Name field.
Enter a negative price value '-5.00' into Price field.
Select 'Home' as Category.
Click the Save button.
scenarios.expected_result: The form submission is rejected with error message 'Price must be zero or more' displayed in an accessibility alert.

scenarios.title: Validate Category Selection and Description Length Limit
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure category is chosen from allowed values and description length does not exceed 500 characters.
preconditions: User is signed in on the Add Product page
steps: Enter valid Product Name and Price.
Leave Category unselected and attempt to save.
Verify error message 'Please choose a category' is displayed.
Select a valid category ('Books').
Enter a Description containing 501 characters and attempt to save.
scenarios.expected_result: System displays error 'Description must be at most 500 characters' and rejects saving until description is within 500 characters.

scenarios.title: HTML and Script Literal Output Encoding in Product Detail View
scenarios.business_objective: Verify that user-supplied HTML or script markup in product description is output-encoded and displayed literally without execution.
preconditions: User is signed in and creates a product with description 'Bold Text'
steps: Submit a product with HTML/Script tags in the description.
Navigate to the created product's detail page.
Inspect the rendered description text.
scenarios.expected_result: The HTML markup 'Bold Text' is displayed literally as plain text on screen; no alert dialog triggers and text is not formatted in bold.

scenarios.title: Prevent Duplicate Product Submission and Double Click
scenarios.business_objective: Prevent accidental creation of duplicate products caused by double-clicking or re-submitting identical details within 5 seconds.
preconditions: User is signed in and filling out the Add Product form
steps: Enter product name 'Smart Lamp', price '45.00', category 'Home'.
Click the Save button twice rapidly (or submit the identical name and price twice within 5 seconds).
Observe the Save button behavior during submission.
scenarios.expected_result: The Save button becomes disabled while saving, and exactly one product record is created in the product list.

scenarios.title: Permanent Product Deletion and Catalogue Removal
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure deleting a product removes it permanently from list/search and renders detail page unavailable.
preconditions: A product exists in the catalogue
User is signed in and viewing product options
steps: Select the Delete action for an existing product.
Observe confirmation message on screen.
Search for the deleted product using catalogue search and browse list.
Attempt to navigate directly to the product detail URL of the deleted product.
scenarios.expected_result: The screen confirms 'Product deleted', the product is permanently absent from search/list results, and navigating to its detail page displays 'Product not found' even after browser reload.

scenarios.title: JSON API Product Creation and Validation via POST /api/products
scenarios.business_objective: Verify that POST /api/products handles JSON product creation and returns HTTP 422 with validation errors when rules are violated.
preconditions: User has an authenticated session cookie or header
steps: Send a POST request to '/api/products' with JSON payload containing negative price: '{"name": "Headphones", "price": -15.00, "category": "Electronics"}'.
Observe response status and error body.
Send a POST request to '/api/products' with valid JSON payload: '{"name": "Headphones", "price": 15.00, "category": "Electronics", "description": "Wired headphones"}'.
scenarios.expected_result: The negative price request returns HTTP 422 with error message 'Price must be zero or more'. The valid request returns HTTP 201/200 and creates the product.

scenarios.title: API Session Authentication and Health Check Endpoint Access
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure unauthenticated API calls return HTTP 401 Unauthorized for secure endpoints while public health check is accessible.
preconditions: User is NOT signed in (no active session)
steps: Send GET request to '/api/health'.
Send GET request to '/api/products'.
Send POST request to '/api/products' with valid JSON.
scenarios.expected_result: '/api/health' responds with HTTP 200 OK. Both GET and POST to '/api/products' return HTTP 401 Unauthorized.

scenarios.title: Role-Based Order Authorization for Customers and Administrators
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure customers can only access their own orders while administrators can view all orders.
preconditions: Orders exist for Customer A and Customer B in the system
steps: Sign in as Customer A and attempt to access Customer B's order via GET '/api/orders/{customer_b_order_id}'.
Sign in as Administrator (`admin`) and attempt to access Customer B's order via GET '/api/orders/{customer_b_order_id}'.
scenarios.expected_result: Customer A receives an authorization error or HTTP 403/401 when requesting Customer B's order. Administrator successfully retrieves Customer B's order details.

scenarios.title: Validate Product Quantity on Cart Creation and Update
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure items added to or updated in the shopping cart have a valid integer quantity between 1 and 99.
preconditions: Customer is signed in and browsing the store product catalog.
steps: 1. Select a product from the shop catalog.
2. Attempt to add the product with an invalid quantity (e.g., 0, -1, 100, or non-numeric text).
3. Observe the validation error displayed by the system.
4. Enter a valid quantity (e.g., 5) and add the product to the cart.
5. Navigate to the cart page and attempt to update the line item quantity to an invalid value (e.g., 0 or 150).
scenarios.expected_result: Invalid quantities are rejected with the message "Quantity must be between 1 and 99". Only whole numbers between 1 and 99 are accepted for adding or updating cart items.

scenarios.title: Exact Monetary Calculation and Half-Up Rounding for Cart Totals
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure line totals, subtotals, discounts, and total order amounts are calculated using exact values and rounded half up to two decimal places.
preconditions: Customer is signed in and has items with fractional pricing in the cart.
steps: 1. Add 1 unit of Gel Pen priced at 1.005 to the cart.
2. Verify the line total on the cart page.
3. Update quantity of Gel Pen to 3 units and verify line total.
4. Add 1 unit of Atlas of Maps priced at 19.95 and apply discount code SAVE10.
5. Review the updated line items, subtotal, discount, and final calculated total.
scenarios.expected_result: 1 x Gel Pen at 1.005 yields $1.01. 3 x Gel Pen yields $3.02. Atlas of Maps at $19.95 with SAVE10 gives a subtotal discount resulting in $17.96 (17.955 rounded half up to 2 decimal places).

scenarios.title: Apply and Validate Cart Discount Codes
scenarios.business_objective: Allow customers to apply legitimate discount codes once per cart while preventing duplicate applications and rejecting invalid codes.
preconditions: Customer is signed in and has at least one item in their shopping cart.
steps: 1. Enter discount code "UNKNOWN123" on the cart summary page and apply.
2. Verify the error message.
3. Enter discount code "SAVE10" and apply.
4. Verify that 10% discount is applied to the cart total.
5. Attempt to apply "SAVE10" a second time on the same cart.
scenarios.expected_result: Unknown codes trigger "Invalid discount code". Valid code SAVE10 reduces cart total by 10%. Re-applying SAVE10 displays "Discount already applied" without modifying the cart total further.

scenarios.title: Prevent Checkout with Empty Cart
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure customers cannot proceed through checkout or place an order if their shopping cart is empty.
preconditions: Customer is signed in and has no items in their cart.
steps: 1. Navigate to the cart / checkout page.
2. Attempt to initiate checkout or place an order.
3. Check the interface and verify whether an order was created.
scenarios.expected_result: The checkout page displays "Your cart is empty", no order is generated in the database, and checkout is blocked.

scenarios.title: Successful Order Placement and Cart Reset
scenarios.business_objective: Process a complete order submission from a non-empty cart, display order details on confirmation page, and empty the cart.
preconditions: Customer is signed in and has items in their shopping cart.
steps: 1. Proceed to checkout from the non-empty cart.
2. Submit order placement.
3. Observe redirection to the order confirmation page.
4. Verify the confirmation page displays "Order #<id>", line items, total, and message "Thank you! Your order #<id> has been placed.".
5. Navigate back to the cart.
scenarios.expected_result: Order is created successfully, confirmation page displays exact line items and total along with the required message, and the active cart is emptied.

scenarios.title: Order Access Control and Authorization Enforcement
scenarios.business_objective: Restrict order access so customers can only view their own orders while administrators can view all orders.
preconditions: Customer A and Customer B have existing orders placed in the store.
An Administrator account exists.
steps: 1. Sign in as Customer A and access Customer A's order page `/orders/<order_A_id>`.
2. Attempt to view Customer B's order page `/orders/<order_B_id>` or via GET `/api/orders/<order_B_id>`.
3. Sign out and sign in as Administrator (`admin`).
4. Access `/orders/<order_A_id>` and `/orders/<order_B_id>`.
scenarios.expected_result: Customer A successfully views their own order. Accessing Customer B's order returns HTTP 403 status with "Access denied". Administrator can successfully access orders for both Customer A and Customer B.

scenarios.title: JSON API Authentication Enforcement
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure all API endpoints except health check require active user authentication.
preconditions: The system API service is running.
No active user session is present.
steps: 1. Send an unauthenticated HTTP GET request to `/api/health`.
2. Send an unauthenticated HTTP GET request to `/api/products`.
3. Send an unauthenticated HTTP POST request to `/api/products`.
4. Send an unauthenticated HTTP GET request to `/api/orders/1`.
scenarios.expected_result: GET `/api/health` returns HTTP 200 OK without authentication. All other requests (`/api/products`, `/api/orders/{id}`) return HTTP 401 Unauthorized.

scenarios.title: Upload valid CSV or PNG file within size limit
scenarios.business_objective: Allow users to successfully upload files in permitted formats (CSV or PNG) that do not exceed the 1 MB size limit.
preconditions: User is authenticated and navigated to the file upload feature.
steps: Select a CSV or PNG file with a file size equal to or less than 1 MB.
Submit the file upload form.
scenarios.expected_result: The file uploads successfully and the application displays the confirmation message 'Uploaded <file name>'.

scenarios.title: Reject file upload with unsupported file format
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure file security and integrity by rejecting files that are not in CSV or PNG format.
preconditions: User is authenticated and navigated to the file upload feature.
steps: Select a file with an unsupported extension (e.g., .exe, .txt, .pdf).
Submit the file upload form.
scenarios.expected_result: The server rejects the file upload and displays the error message 'Only CSV or PNG files are allowed'.

scenarios.title: Reject file upload exceeding maximum size limit
scenarios.business_objective: Prevent system resource exhaustion by rejecting file uploads larger than 1 MB.
preconditions: User is authenticated and navigated to the file upload feature.
steps: Select a valid CSV or PNG file that exceeds 1 MB in size.
Submit the file upload form.
scenarios.expected_result: The server rejects the file upload and displays the error message 'File must be 1 MB or smaller'.

scenarios.title: Enforce order access authorization based on user roles
scenarios.business_objective: Protect customer order privacy by restricting customers to viewing only their own orders while allowing administrators full visibility.
preconditions: Customer is signed in to the application.
Orders exist in the system belonging to both the logged-in customer and other customers.
steps: Request order details for an order placed by the logged-in customer.
Attempt to request order details for an order placed by a different customer via the UI or GET /api/orders/{id} endpoint.
scenarios.expected_result: The customer successfully retrieves details for their own order, but access is denied when requesting another customer's order.

scenarios.title: Require authentication for API mirror endpoints except health check
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure all API endpoints are secured behind session authentication except for public health monitoring.
preconditions: User is not authenticated (unauthenticated HTTP client session).
steps: Send an HTTP GET request to /api/health.
Send an HTTP GET request to /api/products.
Send an HTTP GET request to /api/orders/123.
scenarios.expected_result: The /api/health request responds successfully with system status, whereas requests to protected endpoints (/api/products, /api/orders/{id}) return HTTP status 401 Unauthorized.

scenarios.title: Invalidate user session upon logout
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure complete session destruction on logout to prevent unauthorized access through reused session identifiers.
preconditions: User is signed in with an active session.
steps: Perform an action requiring authentication.
Click the logout control to end the session.
Attempt to perform a subsequent authenticated request or access a protected route using the terminated session.
scenarios.expected_result: The session is invalidated upon logout and subsequent access attempts are rejected, requiring the user to re-authenticate.

scenarios.title: Administrator accesses the Admin page
scenarios.business_objective: Allow administrators to access user and role management pages.
preconditions: User is logged in with an Administrator account.
steps: Navigate to `/admin` endpoint.
scenarios.expected_result: The Admin page displays successfully, listing system users and their assigned roles.

scenarios.title: Non-administrator access attempt to Admin page is denied
scenarios.business_objective: Prevent non-administrator users from accessing administrative management pages.
preconditions: User is signed in with a standard non-administrator Customer account.
steps: Attempt to navigate to the `/admin` URL.
scenarios.expected_result: Access is denied, returning HTTP status code 403 with exact text message "Access denied".

scenarios.title: Unauthenticated public health check API request
scenarios.business_objective: Provide a public API health monitoring endpoint that does not require user authentication.
preconditions: System API services are running.
steps: Send an unauthenticated GET request to `/api/health`.
scenarios.expected_result: System responds with HTTP status 200 and JSON body {"status": "ok"}.

scenarios.title: Search, filter, and paginate products via API
scenarios.business_objective: Expose product querying capabilities through a JSON API mirroring UI functionality.
preconditions: User has an active signed-in session.
steps: Send a GET request to `/api/products` with query parameters such as `q`, `category`, `sort`, and `page`.
scenarios.expected_result: System returns HTTP 200 with a JSON list of products filtered, sorted, and paginated according to the supplied request parameters.

scenarios.title: Validate product creation via JSON API
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure product creation payloads via API undergo the same validation rules as the UI form.
preconditions: User has an active signed-in session.
steps: Send a POST request to `/api/products` with invalid JSON field data (e.g., missing required fields or invalid price).
scenarios.expected_result: System rejects the request with HTTP status 422 Unprocessable Entity and returns JSON error messages describing validation failures.

scenarios.title: Restrict customer order details access via API based on ownership
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure users can only view their own order details via the API, while preventing unauthorized order retrieval.
preconditions: Customer A is signed in.
An order exists that belongs to Customer B.
steps: Customer A sends a GET request to `/api/orders/{id}` using Customer B's order ID.
scenarios.expected_result: System denies the request and prevents access to Customer B's order details in accordance with authorization ownership rules.

scenarios.title: Invalidate user session upon logout
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure session invalidation on logout prevents reuse of terminated session credentials.
preconditions: User is currently signed in.
steps: Perform logout action.
Attempt to send an API request requiring authentication (e.g., GET `/api/products`) using the invalidated session identifier.
scenarios.expected_result: System rejects the subsequent API request with HTTP 401 Unauthenticated because the session was invalidated.

scenarios.title: Output encoding for user-submitted content
scenarios.business_objective: Prevent cross-site scripting (XSS) and injection vulnerabilities by encoding all user content rendered in the system.
preconditions: User is signed in and adding/editing a product containing HTML/script tags in the description.
steps: Submit product details containing potential script tags or unescaped HTML characters via POST `/api/products`.
Retrieve and view the created product details.
scenarios.expected_result: User-submitted content is properly output-encoded when rendered, displaying literal characters rather than executing script code.
